verdict.rationale: The AMD Instinct MI325X is a GPU accelerator. It is programmed and managed through software stacks and tools such as ROCm, HIP, AMD SMI and the GPU Operator, not through a product UI, so asking whether the API matches the UI is a category error for this hardware. The pack documents no UI surface that an API could be measured against, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
